stage_objective: Terminalize the already accepted WebGPT-as-Codex project without adding features: verify the Final Overall Acceptance commit and canonical main post-state, confirm the repository remains clean/public-safe and the final acceptance/handoff receipt is consistent, write only the minimum PROJECT-COMPLETE bookkeeping required by evidence, commit if repository state changes, then generate and exactly-once Playwright-submit a fresh TERMINAL prompt from the verified committed HEAD.
required_outputs: read the Final Overall Acceptance closure and verify its committed SOURCE_HEAD/canonical main post-state rather than reopening implementation
confirm final repository status and public-safe boundary remain clean, and distinguish any external MCP/session health drift from repository correctness
verify the machine-local Final Overall Acceptance handoff receipt/prompt hash when available without copying private browser or endpoint state into Git
update only PROJECT-COMPLETE/current-state terminal bookkeeping that is actually required by verified evidence
if repository bookkeeping changes, commit it and regenerate TERMINAL from the new committed HEAD; otherwise use the already verified committed HEAD
validate/hash the exact TERMINAL prompt, Playwright-submit exactly once, and verify sent-message SOURCE_HEAD + /c/ URL + new assistant run before closing
do_not_redo: Stages 0-12 or Final Overall Acceptance implementation and tests unless new contradictory repository-owned evidence appears
new features, architecture redesigns, release repackaging or speculative cleanup
machine-local OAuth/Tailscale credentials, private endpoints, browser profiles, cookies, tokens, PIDs or unrelated repositories
turning transient Serena/Coding Tools/Playwright/external-service health drift into retroactive project failure without repository contradiction
known_risks: Terminal bookkeeping can accidentally reopen already accepted scope; changes must stay minimal and evidence-driven.
The final external handoff remains exactly-once: after send is attempted, only post-state verification is allowed.
External MCP/session availability may drift independently of the accepted repository and must remain classified as harness/runtime evidence.
